DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引出しの現金は、どのような札をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What denominations would you like for the cash you are withdrawing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地域行事で十人へ千円ずつ渡します。千円札十枚にしたいです。十人の名前を書いた封筒もこちらで用意してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十人各千円の札と名入り封筒の準備を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will give one thousand yen each to ten people at a community event. I would like ten one-thousand-yen notes. Could you also prepare envelopes with the ten people's names on them here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for notes giving each of ten people one thousand yen and about preparing named envelopes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現金の取扱いは確認しますが、行事の受領者ごとの封筒作成や仕分けは行っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the cash handling, but we do not prepare envelopes or sort money for each event recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では名前入り封筒は自分で用意します。受領者名簿を銀行へ預けて一人ずつ配ってもらう話ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒名簿仕分けは本人側で行うと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will prepare the named envelopes myself. This is not an arrangement where I leave the recipient list at the bank and have you distribute the money individually, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you will handle the envelopes, name list, and sorting yourself. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望の額は一万円、千円札十枚ということでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: To confirm, you would like ten thousand yen in ten one-thousand-yen notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、一万円です。名簿に十人いるから十万円と書くのではなく、一人千円の合計を確認して記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人額と総額一万円を計算して示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, ten thousand yen. I will not write one hundred thousand yen just because there are ten names on the list; I will check the total at one thousand yen per person and fill it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Calculate and state the per-person amount and the total of ten thousand yen. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お取引の確認後、札の内訳を確認してお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking the transaction, we will confirm the breakdown of notes and hand them to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。封筒へ分ける前に、受け取った合計と枚数を私が確認します。ここで名簿を広げて名前を読み上げません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受領金確認を先にし窓口で名簿を広げない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Before dividing it into envelopes, I will check the total received and the number of notes myself. I will not spread out the name list here and read the names aloud.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the money received first and do not spread out the name list at the counter. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが千円札十枚です。合計一万円をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are ten one-thousand-yen notes. Please check the total of ten thousand yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十枚と一万円を確認しました。行事の受付担当と一緒に名簿を確かめ、一人分ずつ封筒へ分けるのは戻ってからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十枚一万円を確認し主催側で後から配分する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the ten notes and ten thousand yen. I will check the list together with the event reception staff and divide the money into individual envelopes after I return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm ten notes totaling ten thousand yen and arrange distribution later on the organizer's side. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、現金のお持ち帰りにお気をつけください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please take care carrying the cash home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈答用の果物をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for fruit as a gift?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この箱を叔父へ持っていきたいです。今日は歩いて来たので、箱を持ったまま坂道を帰れるか気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩坂道で贈答果物箱を持てるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take this box to my uncle. I walked here today, so I am concerned about whether I can carry the box home up the slopes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about carrying a gift-fruit box while walking home on slopes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この見本をお持ちになる前に、表示の重さをご確認ください。見本の箱には中身が入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before lifting this display sample, please check the indicated weight. The sample box has no contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見本が軽いから持てると思っていました。実際の果物と箱を合わせた重さを見る必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空見本軽さと実重量を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could carry it because the sample was light. I need to check the combined weight of the actual fruit and box, don't I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the light empty sample from the actual weight. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の箱は、ここにございます。安全に持てるか、ご自身の状況に合わせてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The actual box is here. Please choose according to your circumstances and whether you can carry it safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 想像より重いです。片手に日用品の袋もあるので、両方を無理に一度で運ぶのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日用品も持つため一度の過重量を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is heavier than I imagined. I also have a bag of household goods in one hand, so I will not force myself to carry both in one trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid excessive weight in one trip because you are also carrying household goods. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 少ない個数の小箱もあります。お渡しする人数は何人でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are also smaller boxes with fewer pieces. How many people will you give it to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 叔父一人です。見栄えだけで大きい箱にせず、小箱の中身と重さを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取一人向け小箱を見栄えより選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just my uncle. Rather than choose a large box only for its appearance, I would like to look at the contents and weight of a small box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a small box for one recipient rather than prioritizing appearance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの小箱は二個入りです。中身を含めた重さをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This small box contains two pieces of fruit. Please check its weight including the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: これなら持てます。二個入りを選び、軽い展示見本ではなく実際の箱を持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実際二個箱で持運び可能と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can carry this. I will choose the two-piece box and take home the actual box, rather than the light display sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you can carry the actual two-piece box. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、小箱をお会計します。お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will ring up the small box. Please take care carrying it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様と、お店屋さんごっこでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you playing shop with your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。落ちた木の実をお菓子に見立てていました。子どもが口へ持っていこうとしたので、使い方を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 実の菓子ごっこで口へ近付けたため材料変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. We were pretending fallen nuts and berries were sweets. My child tried to bring one to their mouth, so I would like to change how we use the materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about changing materials because your child brought a fallen fruit close to their mouth while playing sweets. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べていないか、まずお確かめください。種類の分からない実を、食べ物として渡さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please check that they have not eaten any. Do not hand over unidentified fruits or nuts as food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口には入れていません。手に持った所で止めました。遊びの物だと説明しても、本物のお菓子に似ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未喫食と制止した時点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They did not put it in their mouth. I stopped them while they were holding it. Even if I explain that it is for play, it looks like real sweets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that none was eaten and at what point you stopped your child. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 口へ入れた物ではないと確認しました。遊びの材料を、ご自身で別に用意できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have confirmed it was not put in their mouth. Can you prepare different play materials yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ってきた絵の紙があります。実を配る代わりに、紙へお菓子を描いて受け渡す遊びにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実を配らず紙の菓子絵へ切替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have drawing paper I brought. Instead of handing out the nuts and berries, we will draw sweets on paper and play at handing those over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Switch from distributing fallen fruits to drawings of sweets on paper. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙が飛ばないよう、場所や風にも気をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consider the location and wind too so the paper does not blow away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 低い台のそばで大人が紙を持ちます。実の名前を教えることより、今は口へ入れない材料へ切り替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大人が紙を保持し口へ入らない材料を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: An adult will hold the paper beside a low table. Rather than teach the names of the nuts and berries, for now I want to switch to materials that will not go into the mouth.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Have an adult hold the paper and prioritize materials that will not go into the mouth. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 使った紙は、お持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take the used paper home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 描いた紙は全部数えて持ち帰ります。木の実を食べ物のふりで渡す遊びはやめ、家でも紙のお店に続けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙回収と家庭でも紙遊び継続を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will count all the drawings and take them home. We will stop pretending fallen nuts and berries are food and continue our paper shop at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to collect the paper and continue playing with paper at home too. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、親子で楽しくお過ごしください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy your time together with your child. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲物の販売機の前でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble at the drink vending machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お金を入れてボタンを押しましたが、飲物が出てきません。もう一度お金を入れる前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自販機に支払い後商品が出ず再投入前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put money in and pressed the button, but no drink came out. I would like to ask for help before putting in more money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help after paying at the vending machine without receiving the item, before inserting money again. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本体の連絡先を確認しましょう。駅の窓口で代金を直接お返しすることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the contact details on the machine. We cannot refund the money directly at the station counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 販売機の番号と管理する会社の番号があります。自分で機械を揺すって出すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 管理番号を見つけ機械を揺すらないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a machine number and the managing company's telephone number. I will not shake the machine myself to get it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you found the management number and will not shake the machine. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入した品と、入れた金額は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know the item you purchased and the amount you inserted?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水を選び、表示の百四十円を入れました。お釣りも出ていません。買い直す前にこの状況を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入水金額と釣銭未返却を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I selected water and inserted the displayed one hundred forty yen. No change came out either. I will report this situation before buying again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you purchased water, the amount, and that no change was returned. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理先へ伝える際は、この機械の番号も添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When reporting it to the management company, include this machine's number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 機械の番号を控えました。管理先へ電話する時、こちらに購入の記録を見せる必要があるかも聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機械番号を控え管理先へ購入記録の必要性も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have noted the machine number. When I call the management company, I will also ask whether I need to show a purchase record here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the machine number and ask the management company whether a purchase record is needed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お時間に余裕はありますか。列車の案内も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have enough time? Do you also need train information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 列車まで余裕があります。ここで管理先へ電話し、機械から離れる場合は購入した時刻もメモしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発車まで余裕があり管理先へ購入時刻を添え連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have time before my train. I will call the management company here, and if I leave the machine, I will also note the time of purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have time before departure and will contact management with the purchase time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先はこちらです。それでは、管理先へご確認ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the contact details. Please check with the management company. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 市の踊りの体験講座についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the city's dance trial course?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。踊りを習ってみたいですが、案内にある発表の日は仕事です。発表に出られなくても体験に参加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発表日に勤務があり練習参加だけできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to try learning the dance, but I work on the performance date in the information. Can I attend the trial even if I cannot perform?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can attend only the practice because you work on the performance date. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この体験講座の練習と、後日の発表参加は別に申し込む形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Applications for practice in this trial course and participation in the later performance are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら練習だけ希望します。発表も出ると返事をして、後から欠席することにはしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発表出席を誤って約束せず練習のみ希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I would like only the practice. I do not want to reply that I will perform too and then be absent later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request only practice without mistakenly promising to attend the performance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 練習の日程をご覧ください。全三回あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look at the practice schedule. There are three sessions in total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三回の練習日は休みなので参加できます。体験したあとで発表の仕事を休めるかは、まだ約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 練習三回出席可と発表休暇は未確約と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am off on all three practice days, so I can attend. I am not yet promising that I can take time off work for the performance after the trial.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can attend all three practices but have not committed to taking leave for the performance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発表の申込みは、必要になった時に締切も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you need to apply for the performance, please also check the deadline then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は発表欄へ名前を書かず、練習三回の申込みだけにします。会場へ持っていく物は案内にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発表欄は未記入で練習申込と持物確認をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: For now, I will leave my name out of the performance section and apply only for the three practices. Does the information list what to bring to the venue?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Leave the performance section blank, apply for practice, and check what to bring. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 動きやすい服など、こちらの参加案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check these participation instructions, including clothing that is easy to move in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち物を控えました。三回の体験を希望して提出し、発表は未申込みという形でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持物を控え体験のみの申込を提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have noted what to bring. I will submit my request for the three trial sessions; please treat the performance as not applied for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note what to bring and submit an application only for the trial. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 体験の申込みを承りました。それでは、初回の会場でお待ちしております。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have accepted your trial application. We look forward to seeing you at the first session's venue. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 松葉杖の説明を始めてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I start explaining the crutches?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。以前使ったことはありますが、その時とは長さも形も違うので、覚えているつもりで歩き出さないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前使用経験はあるが別形状の松葉杖で指導を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please do. I have used crutches before, but these differ in length and shape, so I want to avoid starting to walk just assuming I remember how.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have used crutches before but would like instruction for this different shape. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず合わせた状態を確認します。今は椅子に座ったままでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: First we will check the fit. Please remain seated in the chair for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 座って待ちます。二本を先に自分で短くしてしまうのでなく、このまま見ていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座って待ち自己長さ調整をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will wait seated. Rather than shorten both of them myself first, I will let you check them as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will wait seated without adjusting their length yourself. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 立つ時の使い方も、ここでご説明します。ご自宅で気になる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will explain here how to use them when standing up as well. Is there anywhere at home you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 玄関に一段あります。平らな所を歩く説明だけでなく、その段差についても担当へ質問したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 玄関一段の対応も質問したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is one step at the entrance. In addition to instructions for walking on level ground, I want to ask the person in charge about that step too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you also want to ask how to handle the single step at your entrance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 段差への対応は、ご本人の状態に合わせて確認します。帰宅はどのようになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check how to handle steps according to your condition. How will you get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の車です。車に乗る時も経験だけで急がず、乗り降りの注意を聞いてから迎えを頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族車への乗降注意を聞いてから迎えを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: In my family's car. I will not hurry into the car relying only on experience; I will ask about precautions for getting in and out before asking them to pick me up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask for a pickup after hearing precautions for getting in and out of your family's car. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 玄関の段差の相談を担当へ伝えました。院内から外の乗降場所までは職員が付き添えますので、ご家族の車はその場所へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have told the person in charge about your entrance step. A staff member can accompany you from inside the hospital to the outdoor pickup area, so please have your family bring the car there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族へ乗降場所を伝えました。まずここで使い方を見てもらい、車までは職員の方と一緒に移動します。玄関の段差についても説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定乗降場所を家族へ伝え職員付き添いと段差説明を受ける予定を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have told my family the pickup location. First, I will have you check how I use the crutches here, then go to the car with a staff member. I will also hear the explanation about the entrance step.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you told your family the designated pickup area and plan to receive staff accompaniment and step instructions. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当と一緒に確認を始めます。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will begin checking with the person in charge. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お受取りが済みましたね。ほかに何かありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have finished collecting it. Is there anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布も中の物も確認できました。届けてくれた方へお礼を伝えたいので、どんな方法があるか相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返還財布の中身確認後に拾得者への礼の伝え方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have checked both the wallet and its contents. I would like to thank the person who handed it in; could I ask what ways there are to do that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After checking the returned wallet's contents, ask how to thank the finder. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ伝えます。相手の連絡先をこちらからそのままお渡しすることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will convey your wishes to the person in charge. We cannot simply give you the other person's contact information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連絡先を知りたいというより、助かったと伝えたいです。短いお礼の言葉を担当へ預ける相談でもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手連絡先取得より短い感謝文の預託を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: More than wanting their contact details, I want to tell them how much it helped. Could I ask about leaving a short message of thanks with the person in charge?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request to leave a short thank-you message rather than obtain the other person's contact information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お伝えできる方法を確認します。謝礼についても、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check how we can convey it. Do you also have wishes about a reward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お礼の連絡の方法を先に聞きたいです。金額や渡し方の相談が必要なら、その後で説明を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 謝礼額の前に連絡方法の案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to hear first how to send my thanks. If I need to discuss the amount or how to give it, I will hear that explanation afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the contact method before the reward amount. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 伝える文面には、ご本人が確認したことを簡潔に書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you briefly write what you have personally confirmed in the message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 財布を受け取り、必要な物がそろっていて安心しました。届けてくださりありがとうございます、と書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認できた回復事実と感謝を簡潔な文面にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write: I received my wallet and am relieved that all the necessary items are there. Thank you for handing it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write a short message with the confirmed facts of recovery and your gratitude. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が文面と取扱いを確認します。お返事を必ずいただけるという約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the message and how to handle it. We cannot promise that you will definitely receive a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お礼の文面と私の連絡先を担当へ渡します。返事を急がず、伝えられる方法の案内を受けてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 文面と本人連絡先を渡し伝達方法の案内を受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give my message of thanks and my contact details to the person in charge. I will not rush a reply and will hear how it can be conveyed before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the message and your contact details and receive guidance on conveying it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を承りました。それでは、担当が取扱いをご説明します。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have noted your wishes. The person in charge will explain the handling. Please take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 代金引換のお荷物のお受取りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are collecting a cash-on-delivery parcel, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。現金を持ってきましたが、表示の額より千円足りません。一部だけ払って受け取れると思う前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 代引受取額に千円不足し部分払い可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I brought cash, but I am one thousand yen short of the displayed amount. I want to ask before assuming I can pay only part and collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are one thousand yen short for cash-on-delivery collection and ask whether partial payment is possible. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お受取りには、このお荷物の代金のお支払いが必要です。今日は必要な額を用意できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: To collect it, you need to pay the amount for this parcel. Can you prepare the required amount today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家へ戻れば用意できます。足りないまま受け取るのではなく、今日中にもう一度来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要額を自宅で用意し再来局を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can if I go home. Rather than collect it while short of money, I would like to come back again today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to prepare the required amount at home and return to the post office. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お荷物はまだお渡ししていません。受付の時間を確認してからお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have not handed over the parcel yet. Please check the counter hours before returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付の終わる時刻を確認しました。家は近いので、四時までには戻れます。荷物の受取りは、その時にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付時刻を確認し必要額用意後四時までの再来局を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I checked when the counter closes. My home is nearby, so I can return by four o'clock. Please let me collect the parcel then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the counter hours and ask to return by four after preparing the required amount. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お戻りの時、不在票と確認資料もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you return, bring the missed-delivery notice and verification documents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つともかばんに入れ直しました。支払う額もメモし、必要な現金を足してから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 票資料と必要額メモを整え現金を補充する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put both back in my bag. I will also note the amount to pay and return after adding the cash needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare the notice, documents, and a note of the amount, then replenish your cash. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品を購入したご本人で、お受取りの希望は変わりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are you the person who bought the item, and do you still wish to collect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が注文した品で、受け取ります。今日は受取りを断るのではなく、不足額を用意してから手続きする予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人注文の品で受取拒否ではなく準備後受取を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I ordered it and will collect it. I am not refusing receipt today; I plan to complete the procedure after preparing the missing amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you ordered the item yourself and wish to collect it after preparation, rather than refuse it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご準備後のご来局をお待ちしております。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will wait for you to return after preparing it. Please take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの貸出しの眼鏡で、書類は読めそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you read the documents with these loan glasses?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい字が読みやすくなりました。自分の眼鏡を忘れたので助かりますが、向こうの時計を見るとぼやけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借用眼鏡で近字は見えるが遠時計がぼやけると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The small print is easier to read. They help because I forgot my own glasses, but the clock over there looks blurry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the borrowed glasses make nearby print readable but the distant clock blurry. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類をご覧になるための物です。歩く時には外してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are for reading documents. Please remove them when walking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 遠くを見ようとしたまま歩くのはやめます。ここで座って、まず書類の説明を読み終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 眼鏡で歩かず座って書類を読むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not walk while trying to look into the distance through them. I will sit here and finish reading the document's explanation first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to sit and read the documents without walking in the glasses. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書類で分からない所があれば、担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you do not understand something in the documents, please ask the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この欄だけ意味が分かりません。眼鏡で文字は読めても内容まで理解できたとは限らないので、説明をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 文字可読と内容理解を分け不明欄の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not understand just this field. Being able to read the letters with the glasses does not necessarily mean I understand the content, so please explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish readable text from understanding its content and request an explanation of the unclear field. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この欄は、現在ご希望の連絡方法を選ぶ所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: This field is where you select your currently preferred contact method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞けました。希望を一つ選び、書類を書き終えました。眼鏡は私物と一緒にかばんへ入れないよう返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 欄を選び記入後に眼鏡をかばんへ入れず返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have heard the explanation. I selected one preference and finished the document. I will return the glasses so I do not put them in my bag with my belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the field, finish filling it in, and return the glasses without putting them in your bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの箱へお戻しください。書類も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put them back in this box. I will check the documents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱へ戻しました。外してから立ち上がり、自分の忘れた眼鏡は帰宅後に探します。書類の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却箱へ戻し外して移動し書類確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put them back in the box. I will take them off before standing, and look for my forgotten glasses after getting home. Please check the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return them to the box, remove them before moving, and request a document check. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 貸出品のご返却を確認しました。それでは、書類の受付へお進みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the return of the loan item. Please proceed to the document reception counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買い上げのパンを温めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like us to warm the bread you bought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いしますと言いかけましたが、家まで一時間かかります。ここで温めても、すぐには食べないのです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 温め希望を言いかけたが帰宅まで一時間で即食なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to say yes, but it takes an hour to get home. Even if it is warmed here, I will not eat it immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you nearly requested warming but it takes an hour to get home and you will not eat immediately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お召し上がりになるのは、ご帰宅後でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you eat it after getting home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。焼きたてのように食べたいと思いましたが、帰る間に冷めますね。今日は店では温めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰宅後食事なので店内加温を取りやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I wanted to eat it as though freshly baked, but it will cool on the way home. Please do not warm it in the shop today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Cancel warming in the shop because you will eat after getting home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 温めずにお渡しします。ご自宅での温め方は商品の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will give it to you without warming it. Please check the product instructions for warming it at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内を見ます。家の機械で温める時間まで店員さんに断定してもらうのではなく、自宅で説明を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自宅の機械の案内を読んで準備すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will read the instructions. Rather than have the staff state a definite warming time for my home appliance, I will read the instructions at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare by reading your home appliance's instructions. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋は、このままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is this bag fine as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この袋で持ち帰ります。家で温める時には、買った袋ごと入れてよいとは思わず、包装の扱いも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持帰り袋と加温時包装の扱いを別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take it home in this bag. When warming it at home, I will not assume I can put it in with the purchased bag; I will also check how to handle the packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the carry-home bag separately from how to handle packaging when warming. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが本日お買い上げのパンです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the bread you bought today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。今は温めず、帰って食べる時に準備します。同行者にもまだ食べない分だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未加温品を受け取り帰宅後の準備を予定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received it. I will leave it unwarmed now and prepare it when I get home and eat. I will also tell my companion that this portion is not for eating yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the unwarmed item and plan to prepare it after getting home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お持ち帰りですね。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are taking it home, then. Please take care going home. Thank you.
